revisions.concept: Medium shot: Eli stands on the right side of the frame with both arms raised in joy and an amazed open mouth, as a bright blue stream of water bursts out of a crack in the dark rock tunnel wall beside him. Nothing else. Simple dark background, clear empty top quarter, no lettering.
